title: Remove impact from shipped templates
goal: Remove the impact stage from the flow of both shipped templates (simple.yaml and deployed.yaml), update all tests that pin the roster, clean up unused stubs, and amend ADR-068 §1/§8 — leaving plugins/agent/impact/ and its unit tests untouched.

steps.description: Write RED tests first: update SPEC-18 in template-simple-yaml-test.sh to assert delivery_loop stages are 'design_verify_cycle,build_test_cycle' (dropping impact), and update T1 in core-pipeline-cycle-build-test-wiring-test.sh to assert the same. Both assertions fail on main, proving the tests are meaningful before the implementation lands.

Remove impact from both shipped templates: in simple.yaml remove '- impact' from delivery_loop flow, remove the stage block (lines ~345-373, ~29 lines including the banner comment), remove the delivery_loop banner reference to impact, and remove the 'prior_impact_feedback' / 'impact stage placed AFTER this cycle' comments from the design_verify_cycle banner. In deployed.yaml remove '- impact' from delivery_loop flow and remove the stage block (lines ~170-181, ~12 lines including banner). This makes the step-1 RED tests GREEN.

Fix the remaining pinned assertions in template-simple-yaml-test.sh that are now stale: update SPEC-2 stage count from 20 to 19, remove impact from _expected_stages and shift all indices after it, delete the four SPEC-3 assertions for impact (roles/io/timeout/max_turns), and update SPEC-13's _TPL_STAGES[6] (impact was at index 6; every index from 7 onward must shift down by one).

Clean up unused impact stubs: in tests/lib/run-status-comment-mock-roster.sh remove the dead _make_impact_plugin() function body (lines ~57-91) and the live '_make_plugin "impact" "impact_analyzer"' call (line ~335). In each of the four integration tests (cycle-gate-unavailable-aborts-run-test.sh, cycle-rate-limit-aborts-run-test.sh, cycle-acceptance-terminal-failure-test.sh, cycle-on-max-pipeline-continues-test.sh) remove the inline _make_impact_plugin() function and the '_make_plugin "impact" "impact_analyzer"' call; also remove the impact-referencing comments at lines ~52 and ~61 of cycle-on-max-pipeline-continues-test.sh.

Amend ADR-068: update §1 to read 'design loop → build loop' (removing impact from the flow description), update §8 to remove impact from the list of stages that answer findings, add an 'Amended 2026-10-10' entry to the document header, and update the '## Enforced by' section for §1 to cite tests/unit/template-simple-yaml-test.sh SPEC-18 (which now asserts the two-stage delivery_loop) rather than a route_back refusal test that does not enforce the roster.

notes: Prior exploration (budget-exhausted checkpoint) provided all file-level detail; this plan builds directly on it. Key assumptions: (1) The exact ADR-068 filename is 'ADR-068-nested-loops-and-finding-answers.md' — confirmed from checkpoint. (2) deployed-template-e2e-test.sh and template-blocking-reset-test.sh have no impact references and need no changes — confirmed from checkpoint. (3) All impact plugin unit tests (impact-*-test.sh, design-impact-cycle-*-test.sh, impact-pipeline-test.sh, impact-prefilter-781-regression-test.sh) and tests/unit/core-pipeline-template-test.sh drive the plugin directly or use a fixture template, not simple.yaml/deployed.yaml, so they are unaffected. (4) _make_impact_plugin() in mock-roster and the four integration tests is dead code (it defines but is never called); the live stub path is _make_plugin 'impact' 'impact_analyzer', which registers impact with the mock dispatcher — both must be removed. (5) step-1 is the mandated test-first RED step; the PR body must state what SPEC-18 and T1 asserted before and how they failed after the change. (6) The ADR 'Enforced by' update in step-5 is required for npm run lint (lint-adr-enforced-by.sh) to pass — the current pointer to no-fault-routing-test.sh does not enforce the delivery_loop roster; SPEC-18 does. Gap: the exact line numbers for the ADR file were not read directly — the implementer should read the file before editing. Gap: simple.yaml line count for the delivery_loop banner and design_verify_cycle banner were noted from prior exploration; implementer should re-read to confirm exact line ranges before removing.
